title: Hysteric
summary: HYSTER'IC HYSTER'ICAL, adjective [Gr. from the womb.] Disordered in the region of the womb; troubled with fits or nervous affections.

inlines.v: HYSTER'IC HYSTER'ICAL, adjective [Gr. from the womb.] Disordered in the region of the womb; troubled with fits or nervous affections.
